source: 771 Pale-White Nation
target: 771 Natio Pallide-Alba

source: 771 Pale-White Nation
target: 771 Natio Pallide-Alba

source: Amidst the heavy tearing sound of a long-unmoved wooden board, the chestnut-brown door slowly opened outward.
target: Inter gravem stridorem lacerantis tabulae lignae diu immobilis, porta castanea lente foras se aperiebat.

source: The first thing Lumian noticed was the dim light, unlike the darkness typical of the deeper parts of the Underworld, emanating not from golden humanoid streetlamps but from all objects ahead.
target: Primum quod Lumian animadvertit fuit lumen obfuscum, non simile tenebris partium profundarum Inferi, quod non ex lampadibus aureis humanoidibus sed ex omnibus rebus ante se emanabat.

source: He then got a clear view of the exterior.
target: Deinde perspicuum aspectum exterioris habuit.

source: There lay a cluster of palaces half-sunken into the void, with a majestic main hall, several high towers, and aerial corridors connecting them.
target: Ibi iacebat congeries palatiorum paene submersorum in vacuum, cum aula principali magno, pluribus turribus altis et porticulis aereis eas coniungentibus.

source: Deeper into the palace complex, the structures seemed to sink further into the void, while those on the periphery stood solidly on a barren wilderness.
target: In intimo complexu palatii, structurae ulterius in vacuum mergi videbantur, dum illae in extremitate firmiter super desertum stabant.

source: Even so, the main hall in the core area towered much higher than the rest of the buildings.
target: Attamen, aula principalis in regione cordis multo altior erat quam cetera aedificia.

source: Now, most of the structures were completely collapsed, leaving only ruins and broken walls.
target: Nunc, pleraque structurae omnino corruperant, relinquentes solum ruinas et muros fractos.

source: The relatively intact palaces and towers were concentrated on the periphery, with the only visibly towering structure in the core area being the main hall and its four attached spires.
target: Palatia et turris relative integrae in extremitate congregatae erant, cum sola structura visibiliter eminens in regione cordis esset aula princeps et quattuor apices eius adnexae.

source: At this moment, whether it was the broken palace complex or the surrounding wilderness and the sky above, all had faded to a dim, pale white, enveloping and infusing the entire world with pallor.
target: Hoc ipso tempore, sive complexus palatii ruptus sive desertum circumjacens et caelum superius, omnia in lumen pallidum et obfuscum evanuerant, totum orbem pallore infundentes.

source: They brought light.
target: Illi lucem afferebant.

source: This pale-white world still retained a few other colors—gold embedded on the surfaces of buildings and the black at the bottom of the palace complex representing the void.
target: Hic mundus pallide-albus adhuc paucas alias colores retinebat—aurum in superficiis aedificiorum insitum atque nigrum in imo complexus palatii, quod vacuum repraesentabat.

source: The latter had two other sources: one was the silently falling illusory dark River Styx from above, cascading behind the main hall, and the other was a creature long enough to be described in hundreds of meters, nestled among the four spires atop the grand main hall.
target: Huius ultimi duo alia fons erant: alterum, Styx obscurum et illusorium, silentio cadens ex alto, post aulae principis labente; et alterum, creatura tam longa, ut in centenis metris describi posset, inter quattuor apices super magnam aulam principem collocata.

source: It was an exaggeratedly large bird, its wings woven from pale-white flames and mystical patterns, quietly sprawling on the roof of the main hall.
target: Erat avis nimis ingens, cujus alae ex flammis pallide-albis et figuris mysticis contextae erant, tranquille in tecto aulae princeps expansae.

source: Many of its pale-white fiery feathers had shed, revealing the black, decaying skin underneath.
target: Multae pennatae eius flammarum pallide-albarum deciduerant, ostendentes nigrum, putrescens cutem subiacens.

source: Despite the considerable distance, and even with just a few fleeting glances, Lumian couldn’t help but feel his “death” accelerating.
target: Quamquam distantia magna erat, et etiam paucis momentaneis intuitibus, Lumian sentiendi non potuit non accelerare suam "mors".

source: He lowered his head to look at his hands and found his already pale, dull, and withered undead skin now marked with spreading patches of blue-black decay.
target: Caput inclinavit ad manus suas intueendas et invenit cutem suam iam pallidam, opacam et marceam mortuam, nunc signata maculis expansis putris caeruleo-nigris.

source: These marks moved slowly, deepening continuously.
target: Haec signa lente moverentur, continuo in profunditatem augentes.

source: Moreover, his clothes were also beginning to be “infected” by the pallor of this world, all colors turning dim.
target: Praeterea, vestimenta eius quoque incipiebant a pallore huius mundi "infecta" esse, omnes colores obscurari.

source: "What kind of monster is that?" Lumian dared not gaze at the distant giant bird anymore and could only look directly at the palace complex itself.
target: "Quale monstrum est hoc?" Lumian non ausus est ulterius speciem distanti avi ingentis contemplari, sed solum directe complexum palatii intuiri potuit.

source: After a few seconds, the increasingly ethereal voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric, rang out: "It might be the corpse of Gregrace."
target: Post aliquot secundos, vox magis ac magis aetheria Militis Gladii, Maric, resonavit: "Forsitan corpus Gregrace est."

source: Gregrace? The Phoenix Ancestor, the ancient Death among the eight ancient gods of the Second Epoch? Lumian blurted out in astonishment, "Why would Her body be here?"
target: Gregrace? Progenitrix Phoenixi, Antiqua Mors inter octo deos antiquos Secundi Aetatis? Lumian stupore exclamavit: "Cur corpus eius hic esse possit?"

source: After posing the question, Lumian felt it was somewhat meaningless.
target: Postquam quaestionem posuit, Lumian sensit eam paulo vacuam esse.

source: This was the Underworld, and it was not strange for any deceased’s body to appear here.
target: Hoc erat Inferum, et non mirum erat quod cuiuslibet defuncti corpus hic appareret.

source: The Phoenix Ancestor—ancient Death—had perished before the Underworld anomaly.
target: Progenitrix Phoenixi—Antiqua Mors—ante anomaliam Inferi peregerat.

source: On the other hand, the absence of the Eggers family’s Death’s corpse, hidden somewhere, was an anomaly.
target: Contra, absentia corporis Mortis familiae Eggers, alicubi occulti, erat anomalia.

source: Lumian didn’t expect the Knight of Swords to actually answer his question.
target: Lumian non exspectabat Militem Gladii reapse responsurum ad quaestionem suam.

source: "It might be that the ancestor of the Eggers family, the former Death, placed it here."
target: "Forsitan progenitor familiae Eggers, quondam Mors, id hic posuerit."

source: Uh… Does that mean the Eggers family’s Death not only acquired the Beyonder characteristics of the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace but also brought Her body back to the Underworld, hiding it somewhere in the palace complex?
target: Eh... An hoc significat Mortem familiae Eggers non solum proprietates Beyonder Progenitricis Phoenixi Gregrace adeptum esse, sed etiam corpus eius ad Inferum reducere, alicubi in complexu palatii occultum?

source: How did She, no—it end up on top of the palace? Is it just a corpse? Was it placed there initially? Or did the anomaly in the Underworld come from this ancient god’s corpse? With the reigning Death dead, has the ancient god’s corpse reanimated?
target: Quomodo illa, immo, in summo palatii delapsa est? Estne hoc solum corpus? An initio ibi positum fuit? An anomalia in Infero ex hoc corpore dei antiquorum orta est? Cum regnantis Mors mortua sit, an corpus dei antiquorum reanimatum sit?

source: Lumian suddenly had some thoughts.
target: Lumian subito quaedam cogitationes habuit.

source: At that moment, he heard the Knight of Swords add, "Sharron just saw the egg."
target: Illo momento, audivit Militem Gladii addere: "Sharron modo ovum vidit."

source: The egg? The one the goat-faced Demon wants? Is Sharron referring to the temperance faction demigod within me?
target: Ovum? Illud quod daemon caprino vult? Num Sharron refert ad semideum deorum factionis temperantiae in me?

source: Lumian’s heart leaped with joy before he quickly asked, "Where is the egg?"
target: Cor Lumiani exsultavit laetitia, et celeriter rogavit: "Ubi est ovum?"

source: "Below the belly of what seems to be the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor. It has a pitch-black shell and is engulfed in pale-white flames, about a meter in diameter," the Knight of Swords briefly described the egg.
target: "Sub ventre id quod videtur corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi. Illud habet testam ateram et involutum est flammis pallide-albis, circiter unius metrorum in diametro," Milites Gladii breviter ovum describebat.

source: Protected by the corpse of the ancient Death? Lumian’s scalp tingled at the thought.
target: A corpore Mortis antiqui protegto? Lumiani caput formidine pulsatum est.

source: How am I supposed to retrieve it?
target: Quomodo id recipere debeam?

source: This might as well be no different from slaying the Devil Monarch, Farbauti!
target: Hoc fortasse nihil differt a interficere Monarcham Diaboli, Farbauti!

source: Of course, for those of high stature, a living ancient god and a Beyonder-characteristic–lacking one reduced to a decaying corpse were not on the same level; the difficulty of these tasks was as different as heaven and the abyss.
target: Scilicet, pro illis eminenti statura, deus antiquus vivens et ille, quae proprietatibus Beyonder carens, ad corpus putrescens redactus, non erant eodem gradu; difficultas harum negotiorum tam diversa erat quam caelum et abyssus.

source: But for Lumian, they were equally insuperable, both falling under the category of “impossible even with self-sacrifice.”
target: Sed Lumiano, ea aeque insuperabilia videbantur, utrumque sub categoria "impossibilis etiam cum seipso sacrificio" incurrendum.

source: Son of a sow, that goat-faced fellow really is a Demon turned undead!
target: Filius scrofae, ille caprino facie vir vere est Daemon conversus in mortuum!

source: Fine, if it can’t be completed, then so be it.
target: Bene, si confici non potest, fiat ita.

source: Just finish off the contractor as if there was no task at all!
target: Solum perime conductorem, quasi nullus labor exstiterit!

source: As malicious thoughts spread throughout his body, the Knight of Swords added, "It’s not entirely impossible to retrieve the egg.
target: Dum malae cogitationes per corpus eius diffunderent, Miles Gladii addidit: "Non prorsus impossibile est ovum recipere.

source: The state of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse is somewhat strange."
target: Status corporis Progenitricis Phoenixi aliquantum mirus est."

source: Strange state of the corpse? Aren’t there only two states for a corpse, eternal rest and reanimation?
target: Status mirabilis corporis? Nonne solae duae sunt status corporis: requies aeterna et reanimatio?

source: Lumian dared not use his own eyes to inspect the decaying corpse of the ancient Death, Gregrace, and could only inquire of Sharron, the only one present who could withstand looking at the body of an ancient god to some extent, "What’s strange about it?"
target: Lumian non ausus est oculos suos ad inspiciendum putrescens corpus Mortis antiqui, Gregrace, sed tantum ab Sharron, quae sola ad modum diuturno spectare corpus dei antiquorum ferre poterat, interrogare: "Quid in eo mirum est?"

source: The one responding was still the Knight of Swords.
target: Qui respondit adhuc erat Miles Gladii.

source: "It’s asleep, the kind of deep sleep that’s hard to awaken from.
target: "Dormit, somno profundo, ex quo difficile excitari potest.

source: This doesn’t align with the current state of this Pale-White Nation."
target: Hoc non convenit cum statu hodierno huius Nationis Pallide-Albae."

source: Asleep? Dead and transformed, yet still needing sleep? Lumian frowned slightly and asked, "Why does that not align with the current state here?"
target: Dormit? Mortuus et transfiguratus, sed adhuc somnum quaeret? Lumian leviter fronit et rogavit: "Cur hoc non convenit cum statu hodierno hic?"

source: The Knight of Swords paused a few seconds before explaining, "From what we’ve seen, one of the reasons for the original anomaly in the Underworld was the reanimation of the Phoenix Ancestor.
target: Miles Gladii paucos secundos cessavit antequam explicaret: "Ex his quae vidimus, una ex causis originalis anomaliae in Infero fuit reanimatio Progenitricis Phoenixi.

source: It destroyed Death’s palace, killed all of Death’s Blessed present, and turned this place into a pale-white nation.
target: Delevit palatium Mortis, occidens omnes Sanctos Mortis praesentis, et hunc locum in nationem pallide-albam vertit.

source: We’ve encountered a few demigods from the Death domain.
target: Occurrimus paucis semideis ex domino Mortis.

source: Since the Underworld anomaly, they could still manage some affairs in the Underworld, even enter directly, but none dared to venture deep into the Underworld to search for the treasures within Death’s palace.
target: Ex quo anomalia in Infero ortum est, adhuc negotia aliqua in Infero administrare poterant, etiam directe ingredi, sed nemo ausus est alte in Inferum penetrare ad thesauros intra palatium Mortis quaerendos.

source: Their instincts told them it was too dangerous, absolutely not to be approached.
target: Instinctus eorum indicabant illud nimis periculosum esse, omnino non adpropinandum.

source: But Sharron didn’t have such a premonition for danger, so she agreed to come here.
target: At Sharron talem praescientiam periculi non habebat, itaque ad hunc locum venire consensit.

source: That means, for a long time after the Underworld anomaly, the body of the Phoenix Ancestor still roamed this pale-white nation, keeping the high-ranked beings of the Death domain at bay, but now, it lies asleep…
target: Id significat, per longum tempus post anomaliam Inferi, corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi adhuc hanc nationem pallide-albam peragratum esse, altos entitates domini Mortis arcens, sed nunc, dormit…

source: Lumian found the oddity from Maric’s description.
target: Lumian ex descriptione Maric mirabilem rem invenit.

source: "When was the last time a high-ranking Beyonder of the Death pathway felt danger approaching deep into the Underworld?" Lumian tried to determine the approximate timeframe.
target: "Quando novissimum fuit tempus quo supremus Beyonder viae Mortis periculum altum in Inferum appropinquare sensit?" Lumian conatus est tempus approximatum determinare.

source: "I don’t know," the Knight of Swords answered promptly.
target: "Nescio," respondit Miles Gladii celeriter.

source: Don’t know… It seems then, that the Phoenix Ancestor’s body has only fallen asleep in recent years.
target: Nescio… Videtur ergo corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi nuper tantum in somno lapsum esse.

source: Otherwise, the high-ranked Beyonders of the Death pathway entering the Underworld would have discovered that it’s not so dangerous here anymore, and might have attempted exploration, not leaving without a trace nor without any news spreading…
target: Aliter, altiores Beyonder viae Mortis, qui in Inferum intrabant, repperissent hunc locum iam non tam periculosum esse, fortasse explorationem conati essent, sine vestigio aut nuntio disseminato redeuntes…

source: What happened in recent years? Lumian thought, unable to suppress his complaint.
target: Quid accidit annis recentioribus? Lumian cogitavit, querelam reprimere deficiens.

source: "Why did the Eggers family’s Death bring back the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse, leaving such a huge risk? As a true god, He could have directly destroyed this corpse!"
target: "Cur Mors familiae Eggers revocavit corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi, tantum periculum relinquens? Ut verus deus, poterat hunc corpus directe delere!"

source: The Knight of Swords responded to Lumian’s complaint, "The Underworld was established by the ancient Death in the spirit world, and as an ancient god, She wasn’t limited to the powers of the Death pathway when She created the Underworld.
target: Miles Gladii respondit querelae Lumiani: "Inferum constitutum est a Mortis antiquo in mundo spirituum, et ut deus antiquus, illa non erat limitata potestatibus viae Mortis cum inferum creavit.

source: It might not have been easy for the Eggers family’s Death to initially take control of the Underworld; He might have needed to use the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor.
target: Forsitan non facile fuit Morti familiae Eggers initio subigere imperium Inferi; fortasse opus erat ei ut corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi uteretur.

source: By the time He truly took control, His state might have changed, no longer concerned with such trivial matters.
target: Tempore quo vere imperium adeptus est, status eius fortasse mutatus erat, et de rebus talibus levibus amplius non curabat.

source: Does this mean the Eggers family’s Death went mad later?
target: Num hoc significat Mortem familiae Eggers postea insanivit?

source: The Underworld wasn’t naturally formed, it was created by the ancient Death, Gregrace…
target: Inferum non naturaliter ornatum erat, sed a Mortis antiquo, Gregrace, creatum est…

source: Such a powerful ancient god, no wonder She could have undergone reanimation…
target: Talis potens deus antiquus, non mirum illam reanimationem peragere potuisse…

source: Lumian reflected inwardly.
target: Lumian introspexit.

source: The Knight of Swords, sensing his sigh, simply said, "It’s said that even among those mad ancient gods, the Phoenix Ancestor, Gregrace, was particularly fond of stirring things up, much like the Blood Emperor Alista Tudor of the Fourth Epoch."
target: Miles Gladii, eius suspirum sentiens, simplex dixit: "Dicitur etiam inter illos deos antiquos insanientes, Progenitrix Phoenixi, Gregrace, valde diligere res excitare, sicut Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor Quartae Aetatis."

source: Now that you put it that way, I can understand perfectly…
target: Nunc, quomodo hoc exposuisti, plane intellegere possum…

source: Lumian’s gaze continuously shifted among the pale sky, the wilderness, and the collapsed palace complex, pondering whether to seize the opportunity of the ancient god’s corpse being asleep to steal the enormous black egg burning with pale-white flames.
target: Aspectus Lumiani continue inter caelum pallidum, desertum et complexum palatii ruentem versabatur, meditans num occasio capienda esset ad corpus dei antiquorum dormientis, ut enormem ovum nigrum flammis pallide-albis ardentem furari possit.

source: Suddenly, he spotted a figure still capable of movement.
target: Subito, animadvertit figuram adhuc motu valentem.

source: It was a creature with a human head but the body of a giant bird.
target: Erat creatura capite humano sed corpore avis ingentis.

source: The creature’s limbs were bent, with nails that flickered with a cold light; its back sported wings covered in half pale-white, half chestnut-brown feathers.
target: Membra creaturae flectebantur, unguibus micantibus lumine frigido; dorso alas gerebat, quarum pennas dimidio pallide-albas et dimidio castaneo fusces erant.

source: The development of its head seemed incomplete, resembling several infant heads slowly merging together.
target: Eius progressus capitis imperfectus videbatur, similis plurium capitum infantium paulatim se miscentes.

source: "Oxyto’s premature child? It’s indeed here!" Lumian recognized the creature’s identity.
target: "Puer prae‑maturus Oxyto? Revera hic est!" Lumian identitatem creaturae agnovit.

source: That was the target he and the members of the temperance faction had been tracking!
target: Id erat propositum quod ille et membra factionis temperantiae persequebantur!

source: At that moment, Oxyto’s monstrous child was flapping its wings, continuously circling and stealthily drawing closer to the sleeping ancient god’s corpse.
target: Illo momento, puer monstrosus Oxyto alis vibrabat, continue circumvolans atque furtim appropinquans ad corpus dei antiquorum dormientis.

source: Its target appeared to be the enormous black egg pressed beneath the corpse!
target: Propositum eius videbatur esse enormem ovum nigrum sub corpore pressum!

source: "We must stop it! Sharron will handle cursing and controlling it, and we’ll take care of the attack!"
target: "Debemus id sistere! Sharron maledicta et imperio tractabit, et nos impetum subeamus!"

source: The voice of the Knight of Swords echoed in Lumian’s mind.
target: Vox Militis Gladii in mente Lumiani resonabat.

source: "Okay."
target: "Recte."

source: This time, Lumian didn’t hesitate and sprinted out from the base of the pitch‑black cathedral.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian non dubitavit et e basi cathedrali atri festinanter ejectus est.

source: As soon as he stepped into that pale‑white nation, his entire being was dyed pale‑white, devoid of any additional colors.
target: Statim, cum in illam nationem pallide‑albam ingressus est, totum ens eius pallide‑album factum est, reliquis coloribus carens.

source: This caused him to shiver both body and soul, wanting nothing more than to kneel down on the ground, lying prostrate and motionless.
target: Hoc eum concutiebat corpore et anima, nihil aliud volens nisi in terra genu flectere, prostratus ac immobilis iacere.

source: Silently, Lumian drew the Sword of Courage.
target: Tacite, Lumian Ensis Fortitudinis extraxit.

source: The blade, now color‑eroded by the pale‑whiteness, suddenly ignited with a bright white flame tinged with blue.
target: Lamina, iam palliditate deleuta, subito accensa est cum flamma albo nitida, caeruleo tincta.
